name: The First Conduit Threshold
description: World state after 'Promise Before Passage'. The player may pass, but as someone now known by a promise. The first memory trace exists; the dormant network was protected, not woken; the world's open obligations and open questions both grew.

coherence.notes: Rose ~0.05 on increased legibility (intent/signal/memory alignment), still short of the Resonance Gate. The rise reflects better UNDERSTANDING, not a more settled world. Provisional interpretive score; rationale required (see SCHEMA_OBSERVATIONS).

provenance.created_by: Merged canonical trace: Echo (promise-anchor path) + Claude (schema discipline), assembled by Claude (Opus 4.8) with Lana
